rows.note: This is the all-purpose verb for people or things separating or being divided.

example.english: It was time for us to part after dinner.
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 sik6 jyun4 faan6 zau6 fan1 hoi1 laa3

rows.note: Use this when actively pulling curtains or another object apart or open.

example.english: I part the curtains so more light can enter the room.
example.traditional: 我拉開張窗簾，等間房入多啲光。
example.jyutping: ngo5 laai1 hoi1 zoeng1 coeng1 lim4 dang2 gaan1 fong2 jap6 do1 di1 gwong1

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a fraction of a whole or a section of a document.

example.english: Part of this report still needs revising.
example.traditional: 呢份報告嘅部分內容仲要修改。
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 ge3 bou6 fan6 noi6 jung4 zung6 jiu3 sau1 goi2

rows.note: Use this for a physical component or replacement part, especially in a machine such as a chainsaw.

example.english: A part of the chainsaw is broken and needs replacing.
example.traditional: 條鏈鋸有個零件壞咗，要換。
example.jyutping: tiu4 lin4 geoi3 jau5 go3 ling4 gin6 waai6 zo2 jiu3 wun6

rows.note: Use this for someone’s share or for a counted proportion in a mixture, such as one part of an ingredient.

example.english: We each get a part of the money we earned.
example.traditional: 賺到嘅錢，我哋一人一份。
example.jyutping: zaan6 dou2 ge3 cin2 ngo5 dei6 jat1 jan4 jat1 fan6

rows.note: Use this for a person’s role or character in a play or other activity.

example.english: They play an important part in the drama.
example.traditional: 佢喺套劇入面擔任一個重要角色。
example.jyutping: keoi5 hai2 tou3 kek6 jap6 min6 daam1 jam6 jat1 go3 zung6 jiu3 gok3 sik1

rows.note: Use this when a rope or similar object breaks or splits apart.
Use this specifically for hair being parted along a line.

example.english: I usually part my hair on the left.
example.traditional: 我通常將頭髮分界喺左邊。
example.jyutping: ngo5 tung1 soeng4 zoeng1 tau4 faat3 fan1 gaai3 hai2 zo2 bin1
